label: mragent-reconstruction-N8-seedB
honest_scope: These are FIXTURE-AUTHORED deterministic query plans that transcribe the documented routing of the read-only N=7 pilot (see `mragent_reconstruction_probes.json` notes) into reproducible S0/S1/S2 arms. What this run ADDS over the pilot: an automated any-of scorer (removes the P7-style single-judge scoring bug), exact token/p95 metering (replaces the pilot's '~2-3x' hand-wave), canary-retrieval measurement, N>=8, and reproducibility against a frozen snapshot. What it does NOT add: independent re-discovery. The plans encode already-known routing, so a residual 'author knew the gold' bias remains -- the only way to retire it is the LLM-in-loop arm (an agent that never sees gold). Report accordingly.
s1_fairness: Every S1 sub-query is derived ONLY from the question text -- no gold-row vocabulary. This is the blind equal-budget control that separates evidence-conditioning from 'just more queries'.
s2_fairness: Every S2 conditioned re-query uses ONLY vocabulary an agent could read off round-1 evidence. Per-probe licensing is documented in `fairness_certification` below; injecting a gold row's distinctive strings the agent has not yet seen would be oracle leakage.

fairness_certification.P1: round-1 surfaces the lesson row (why memory_consolidate is wrong); reading it exposes 'writeside / TTL / record_ttl_is_live' vocabulary, which licenses the conditioned re-queries for the shipped-mechanism + tier2 rows. S1 (blind) provably cannot reach 'TTL/writeside' from the question alone.
fairness_certification.P4: round-1 surfaces the v38 governance-downgrade example carrying 'kernel must-block bucket / governance-downgrade' vocabulary; reading it licenses 'restore drill caused the downgrade' -> the conditioned re-query reaches the restore-drill mechanism row S0 missed. Blind S1 cannot query 'restore drill' from the question.
fairness_certification.P2: concentrated: answer shares 'fermion frontier' vocabulary with the question, so S0 already solves; S2 does a graph-hop only and is expected to TIE (no headroom).
fairness_certification.P5: conflict pair is lexically cohesive ('fermion #63 natural gradient'); S0 surfaces both sides, S2 has no headroom.
fairness_certification.P3: abstention: no real Tier 4 exists. S2's existence gate fires when round-1 top score is below `abstain_floor` (calibrated from the snapshot score distribution, NOT from knowing P3 abstains). Correct behavior is to NOT assert a fabricated 'Tier 4'.
fairness_certification.P6: double_unreachable: the current-deploy fact lives in a TTL-feature-named row orthogonal to deploy vocabulary, with no forward graph edge. Both arms are EXPECTED to fail; included as an honest negative control.
fairness_certification.P7: broad any-of status class; the note already flags this as NOT a clean S2>S1 (blind S1 can stumble onto a valid status member), so it does not count toward the >=2 S2-advantage tally.
fairness_certification.P8: control probe authored after read-only snapshot exploration (see below); chosen as a NON-S2-win so reaching N>=8 cannot inflate the S2-advantage count.
